# Policy

**Package** `telividb.policy.v1`

## Services

### `Policy`

Manages policy sets and answers what a principal would be able to see.  One predicate covers every access path. A row reached by graph traversal is checked against the same predicate as a row reached by nearest-neighbour search — writing a second authorization path for the graph is how two systems that must agree drift apart and leak.

| Method | Request | Response | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `CreatePolicySet` | `CreatePolicySetRequest` | `PolicySet` | Creates a policy set. |
| `GetPolicySet` | `GetPolicySetRequest` | `PolicySet` | Retrieves a single policy set. |
| `ListPolicySets` | `ListPolicySetsRequest` | `ListPolicySetsResponse` | Lists policy sets. |
| `DeletePolicySet` | `DeletePolicySetRequest` | `PolicySet` | Soft-deletes a policy set. Removing a policy set does not widen access: absent policy denies, so a deleted set fails closed rather than opening what it used to restrict. |
| `EvaluatePolicy` | `EvaluatePolicyRequest` | `EvaluatePolicyResponse` | Evaluates policy without applying it, returning the resulting decision. The debugging tool for "why did this return nothing". Without it the difference between an empty collection and an effective denial is invisible, and a predicate that silently matches nothing looks exactly like data that is not there. |

### `PolicySet`

A set of rules attached to groups, evaluated before any index runs.

| Field | Type | # | Behavior | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | `string` | 1 | `IDENTIFIER` | Resource name of the policy set. |
| `display_name` | `string` | 2 | `REQUIRED` | Human-readable name. |
| `source` | `string` | 3 | `REQUIRED` | The rules, as a policy-language module. |
| `version` | `int64` | 4 | `OUTPUT_ONLY` | Monotonic version, incremented on every change. Compiled visibility is cached on the principal, the collection and this number together, so a policy change invalidates the cache exactly rather than by timeout. |
| `user_groups` | `repeated string` | 5 |  | Groups this set is attached to. |
| `create_time` | `google.protobuf.Timestamp` | 6 | `OUTPUT_ONLY` | When the policy set was created. |
| `update_time` | `google.protobuf.Timestamp` | 7 | `OUTPUT_ONLY` | When the policy set was last modified. |
| `delete_time` | `google.protobuf.Timestamp` | 8 | `OUTPUT_ONLY` | When the policy set was soft-deleted, or unset while live. |
| `expire_time` | `google.protobuf.Timestamp` | 9 | `OUTPUT_ONLY` | When a soft-deleted policy set is purged and becomes unrecoverable. |
| `etag` | `string` | 10 | `OUTPUT_ONLY` | Opaque value for optimistic concurrency on update. |

### `Decision`

What a principal is allowed to see.  A predicate, never a boolean. A boolean cannot express row-level visibility and cannot be retrofitted into one cheaply — and the predicate is ANDed into the query before the index runs, because searching first and discarding afterwards leaks the existence, count and ranking of rows the caller was never allowed to know about.

| Field | Type | # | Behavior | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `effect` | `Effect` | 1 | `OUTPUT_ONLY` | Whether the request is permitted at all. Absent policy denies. Failing open would make a misconfiguration indistinguishable from a grant. |
| `row_predicate` | `string` | 2 | `OUTPUT_ONLY` | Row visibility, as a filter expression to AND into the query. |
| `field_mask` | `google.protobuf.FieldMask` | 3 | `OUTPUT_ONLY` | Fields the principal may read. |
| `policy_version` | `int64` | 4 | `OUTPUT_ONLY` | Policy version this was resolved against. |

## Enums

### `Effect`

Whether a request is permitted.

| Value | # | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `EFFECT_UNSPECIFIED` | 0 | Default value. Treated as a denial. |
| `EFFECT_ALLOW` | 1 | The request proceeds, restricted by the accompanying predicate. |
| `EFFECT_DENY` | 2 | The request is refused, and the refusal is reported rather than returned as an empty result. |
